const portfolio = $('Calculate Portfolio Value').first().json;

const merchants = [
  {
    id: "SHOP001",
    name: "Newegg",
    category: "Electronics",
    description: "Computers, components, electronics",
    accepts: ["BTC", "BCH", "ETH", "USDT", "DOGE"],
    paymentProcessor: "BitPay",
    website: "https://www.newegg.com",
    minOrder: 0,
    shipping: "Worldwide",
    note: "Major electronics retailer, 20+ years accepting crypto"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP002",
    name: "Overstock",
    category: "Home & Furniture",
    description: "Furniture, home decor, bedding",
    accepts: ["BTC", "ETH", "LTC", "BCH", "DOGE"],
    paymentProcessor: "Direct",
    website: "https://www.overstock.com",
    minOrder: 0,
    shipping: "US & International",
    note: "First major retailer to accept Bitcoin (2014)"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP003",
    name: "eGifter",
    category: "Gift Cards",
    description: "Gift cards for 300+ brands",
    accepts: ["BTC", "ETH", "USDT", "LTC"],
    paymentProcessor: "Direct",
    website: "https://www.egifter.com",
    minOrder: 1,
    shipping: "Digital delivery",
    note: "Instant delivery, buy any brand with crypto"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP004",
    name: "Purse.io",
    category: "Amazon Marketplace",
    description: "Buy anything on Amazon with crypto",
    accepts: ["BTC", "BCH"],
    paymentProcessor: "P2P",
    website: "https://purse.io",
    minOrder: 5,
    shipping: "Amazon shipping",
    note: "Save 5-15% on Amazon purchases with crypto"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP005",
    name: "Shopify Stores (thousands)",
    category: "Various",
    description: "Many Shopify stores accept crypto",
    accepts: ["BTC", "ETH", "USDT", "LTC"],
    paymentProcessor: "Coinbase Commerce",
    website: "Various",
    minOrder: 0,
    shipping: "Varies",
    note: "Search for 'accepts cryptocurrency' on Shopify stores"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP006",
    name: "Namecheap",
    category: "Domains & Hosting",
    description: "Domain names, web hosting, SSL",
    accepts: ["BTC", "BCH"],
    paymentProcessor: "Direct",
    website: "https://www.namecheap.com",
    minOrder: 0.88,
    shipping: "Digital",
    note: "Domains and hosting services"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP007",
    name: "ExpressVPN",
    category: "VPN Service",
    description: "Premium VPN service",
    accepts: ["BTC"],
    paymentProcessor: "BitPay",
    website: "https://www.expressvpn.com",
    minOrder: 8.32,
    shipping: "Digital",
    note: "Fast VPN, accepts Bitcoin"
  },
  {
    id: "SHOP008",
    name: "CheapAir",
    category: "Travel",
    description: "Flights, hotels, car rentals",
    accepts: ["BTC", "BCH", "LTC", "DASH"],
    paymentProcessor: "Direct",
    website: "https://www.cheapair.com",
    minOrder: 0,
    shipping: "Digital tickets",
    note: "Book travel with crypto since 2013"
  }
];

// Filter by affordability
const affordable = merchants.filter(m => 
  m.minOrder <= portfolio.portfolioValue.totalUSDRaw
);

// Group by category
const categories = {};
merchants.forEach(m => {
  if (!categories[m.category]) categories[m.category] = [];
  categories[m.category].push(m);
});

return [{
  json: {
    allMerchants: merchants,
    affordableMerchants: affordable,
    totalMerchants: merchants.length,
    affordableCount: affordable.length,
    categories: Object.keys(categories),
    byCategory: categories,
    portfolioValue: portfolio.portfolioValue.totalUSD
  }
}];
